item.title: Ferrari F76 Digital Hypercar Concept
item.description: Ferrari has unveiled the F76, its first digital model, celebrating its first Le Mans victory 76 years ago. The design uses a parametric - generative approach combined with the current technical-stylistic language.

item.title: Mazda Vision X-Compact Concept
item.description: The Mazda Vision X-Compact is a study of a compact car designed with a focus on the bond between people and vehicles, through the fusion of a human sensory digital model and empathetic Al.

item.title: Bugatti Tourbillon: the Design
item.description: Bugatti has published the second episode of its 'A New Era' design documentary, in which Chief Exterior Designer Jan Schmid give insights on the development of the Toubillon Hypercar.

item.title: Audi Concept C
item.description: The Audi Concept C is a study of an all-electric sports car which introduces a renewed design language that previews the direction for the brand's future models.

item.title: Lexus LS Concept
item.description: At the Japan Mobility Show 2025 Lexus has unveiled the LS Concept, a six-wheeled vehicle with a bold, angular design, aimed at offering passengers a roomy interior focused on space and privacy. item.title: Honda 0 Alpha Concept
item.description: Unveiled at the Japan Mobility Show 2025, the Honda 0 α is a study of a next-generation EV that previews a global production model set to make its debut in 2027.

item.title: Honda Prelude: Design Sketches
item.description: A set of official design sketch renders of the new Honda Prelude, launched in September.

item.title: Bentley Supersports
item.description: Bentley has revealed the new Supersports, a 666 PS, V8-powered sportscar with an aerodynamic exterior based on the Continental GT. It will be produced in a limited run of 500 units.

item.title: Hyundai previews Crater Concept
item.description: The Crater Concept is a study of an off-road compact SUV, created by the Hyundai America Technical Center (HATCI) in Irvine, Calif. and inspired by the spirit of adventure. It makes its debut at AutoMobility LA 2025.

item.title: Ferrari Design. Creative Journeys 2010-2025
item.description: Turin MAUTO Museum has inaugurated the exhibition "Ferrari Design. Creative Journeys 2010-2025", in collaboration with Ferrari Museums and the Ferrari Design Center. It is open until 8 March 2026.
